decision.preferred_transport_implementation: Unresolved pending repeated cost measurements; preserve both registered implementations.
decision.measured_performance: Round32 candidate and control have exactly equal reported validation AUC 0.6151021885074872, unweighted Logloss 0.19653258393542125, and all 23 slice dictionaries. Candidate training is 3.759924 seconds lower and wall is 2.756077 seconds lower, while inference is 0.414867 seconds higher. One fixed-order pair establishes no stable efficiency improvement.
decision.mechanism_evidence: Candidate-authored synthetic float32/float64 and same-checkpoint 512-impression logit/parameter-VJP checks support bounded implementation consistency. They do not independently establish full-training gradient equivalence. Earlier four-cell results give conditional single-seed controlled support for pairing-dependent backward-scale effects.
decision.difference_from_prior_work: Round32 replaces the final cancelling surrogate transport expression with an identity-VJP implementation in an inherited model. It introduces no new prediction architecture or separately established optimization mechanism. Target-aware relevance/products are inherited; novelty and priority remain unverified.

observations.statement: All 92 authorized own-arm receipt references resolve: 88 successes and four execution failures. Indexed status, AUC and wall fields agree. Every successful validation reports 3,234,051 impressions. These dependent replays, source versions and controls are not 92 independent mechanisms or initializations.

Round32 candidate and contemporaneous reference succeed with identical population AUC, Logloss and all 23 reported slice dictionaries. They also retain the round30 aligned-half slice records, 17,130,275 parameters (17,078,688 embedding; 51,587 dense), and 902,733,312 peak GPU bytes. Reported aggregate equality is weaker than full per-example prediction equality.

Round32 candidate minus reference: train -3.7599244416 s (-0.6947527%), wall -2.7560773939 s (-0.4361564%), inference +0.4148674458 s (+2.3119603%), throughput -2.2597166%, batch p50 +0.2987385 ms and p95 +0.2543136 ms. Notes declare a fixed execution order, reference then candidate. Timing uncertainty and order effects are unmeasured.

Both latest schema10 records succeed with 55 finite scalar values; only identity_vjp_enabled differs. Synthetic float32 and float64 primitive/product forward and VJP errors, same-checkpoint model logit error, and all 31 parameter-tensor VJP errors are reported as zero. This is candidate-supplied bounded evidence, not an independent implementation audit.

Latest diagnostics cover 512 ordered validation impressions, 60,475 valid events, four empty histories, one eligible singleton and 507 eligible multiple-event rows. There are zero natural floor/boundary cases. Synthetic shortcut checks include four floor cases and one boundary case; logits/VJPs are finite and padding/empty-summary checks report zero. Natural rare-path coverage is limited.

Round31 inference shortcut also preserves population/slice metrics. Its single-pair inference time falls by 0.3991248459 s (2.1381788%), but train and total wall rise. Round32 uses the inference shortcut in both arms; its timing contrast does not retest the round31 flag-on/off effect.

Baseline static, pooled-history and target-aware validation AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861. The aligned-half/no-row anchor improves the original target-aware reference by 0.0017402023884 AUC and -0.0002620625394 Logloss. This historical contrast bundles changes and execution times.

In the declared common executable family, half-minus-full AUC is +0.0001204973277 for aligned and +0.0004667050401 for crossed pairing. The crossed-minus-aligned interaction is +0.0003462077124 AUC and -0.0002963215009 Logloss. Aligned half is best on both population metrics among the four cells. No independent seed has been observed.

Aligned half improves 15/23 overlapping slice AUCs and 16/23 losses; crossed half improves 20/23 AUCs and 23/23 losses. Aligned empty-history and history1_16 AUC and Logloss both worsen. These are exploratory subgroup findings, with only 310 positives in the empty-history slice.

Full history-count correction loses AUC in both pooled and target-aware models. Partial correction improves pooled AUC but loses target-aware AUC. These are successfully executed negative/mixed results, not missing data or execution failures.

Same-field products improve over ordinary products locally, and aligned unit-normalized products outperform crossed controls. Constant/history-mean derivative alternatives nearly match full normalization; combined half routing outperforms query-only/history-only AUC. These controls leave generic conditioning, shared representation adaptation and optimizer dynamics plausible.

Historical magnitude AUC 0.6152795936767026 becomes 0.6149279138846995 in exact-source/config replay. Same-source round23 magnitude duplicates also differ. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.0000243280764 AUC and -0.0000015627888 Logloss; round27 is -0.0001685358866 AUC and +0.0000613134750 Logloss. Preserve all signs; a reliable incremental magnitude benefit is unestablished.

Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy variants lose AUC against their none controls. Raw-gradient norm/direction controls do not match actual Adam updates, so they do not isolate semantic conflict resolution.

Candidate-owned aggregation shadows report a represented Adam-update difference of 1.4901161193847656e-8 at call512, but zero at call8192 and earlier calls0/1. Fixed-tree aggregation remains shadow-only. These mixed local probes establish neither training-wide numerical repair nor final-score mediation.

Round28 observer-free none retains reported parent population/slice metrics with lower recorded train/wall/memory. Historical timing across source versions is confounded. Latest transport checks do not resolve the cause of magnitude score variation.

Four round21 trace-v1 jobs fail with the recorded float32/64 support RuntimeError and null validation. Their recorded wall total is 21.4754219353 s. Later typed tracing succeeds; this does not erase failures or identify the original offending tensor/dtype.

Latest knowledge-usage IDs, source hashes, statuses and variant names agree with both executed round32 receipts; status is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Declared use is provenance rather than evidence of causal knowledge value.
